WITH w AS (SELECT WK_END_DT, SUM(TRX_QTY) trx FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY WHERE PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110') GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT WK_END_DT, trx, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) rn FROM w)
SELECT CASE WHEN rn<=13 THEN 'L13' WHEN rn<=26 THEN 'P13' END per, MIN(WK_END_DT), MAX(WK_END_DT), SUM(trx), AVG(trx), REGR_SLOPE(trx, DATEDIFF(day,'2026-01-02',WK_END_DT)/7) slope_per_wk FROM r WHERE rn<=26 GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT WK_END_DT, PRSCRBR_ME, PROD_NDC11, PLAN_ID, CHNL_CD, COUNT(*) c FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY WHERE PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

WITH t AS (SELECT PARENT_MATERIAL_ID root, PARENT_MATERIAL_ID parent, CHILD_MATERIAL_ID child, QTY_PER, 1 lvl FROM dbo.BOM WHERE PARENT_MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN EFF_FROM AND EFF_TO
UNION ALL SELECT t.root, b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID, b.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID, b.QTY_PER, t.lvl+1 FROM t JOIN dbo.BOM b ON b.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID=t.child AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b.EFF_FROM AND b.EFF_TO WHERE t.lvl<8)
SELECT t.root, t.lvl, t.parent, t.child, t.QTY_PER, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.MATERIAL_TYP FROM t LEFT JOIN dbo.MATERIAL m ON m.MATERIAL_ID=t.child ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT b1.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID root, b1.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID c1, b2.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID c2, b3.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID c3, b4.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID c4
FROM dbo.BOM b1
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b2 ON b2.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID=b1.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b2.EFF_FROM AND b2.EFF_TO
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b3 ON b3.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID=b2.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b3.EFF_FROM AND b3.EFF_TO
LEFT JOIN dbo.BOM b4 ON b4.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID=b3.CHILD_MATERIAL_ID AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b4.EFF_FROM AND b4.EFF_TO
WHERE b1.PARENT_MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND '2026-09-30' BETWEEN b1.EFF_FROM AND b1.EFF_TO ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, CASE WHEN PROMISED_SHIP_DT < '2026-08-01' THEN 'a_pre_Aug' ELSE 'b_Aug_Sep' END per, COUNT(*) n_due, SUM(CASE WHEN ACTUAL_SHIP_DT > PROMISED_SHIP_DT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late, AVG(CASE WHEN ACTUAL_SHIP_DT IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(day,PROMISED_SHIP_DT,ACTUAL_SHIP_DT)*1.0 END) avg_days_late, SUM(CASE WHEN ACTUAL_SHIP_DT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) not_shipped
FROM dbo.PURCH_ORD WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('CMP-501','CMP-502','CMP-510','RM-103','CMP-310','RM-101','CMP-520','CMP-530','CMP-540') AND PROMISED_SHIP_DT BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, CASE WHEN PROMISED_SHIP_DT < '2026-08-01' THEN 'a_pre_Aug' ELSE 'b_Aug_Sep' END ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MAX(SHIP_DT) last_ship, SUM(CASE WHEN SHIP_DT>'2026-09-25' THEN UNITS ELSE 0 END) units_after_0925 FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') GROUP BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID ORDER BY 1,2
